article.headline: Pistons host Raptors Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.description: Toronto Raptors (5-10, ninth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (10-4, third in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Pistons host Raptors Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.linkText: Pistons host Raptors Friday for NBA Cup group stage matchup
article.story: Toronto Raptors (5-10, ninth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Detroit Pistons (10-4, third in the Eastern Conference) Detroit; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST LINE: Pistons -1.5; over/under is 227.5 BOTTOM LINE: The Detroit Pistons face the Toronto Raptors in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Pistons are 8-3 in conference games. Detroit is fourth in the NBA with 28.0 assists per game. Cade Cunningham leads the Pistons averaging 7.8. The Raptors are 4-6 against conference opponents. Toronto is at the bottom of the Eastern Conference recording only 40.6 rebounds per game led by Jakob Poeltl averaging 6.6. The Pistons average 115.4 points per game, 3.4 more points than the 112.0 the Raptors give up. The Raptors are shooting 45.4% from the field, 1.3% higher than the 44.1% the Pistons' opponents have shot this season. TOP PERFORMERS: Cunningham is averaging 25.8 points, 5.2 rebounds and 7.8 assists for the Pistons. Daniss Jenkins is averaging 2.5 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Immanuel Quickley is shooting 41.1% and averaging 17.8 points for the Raptors. Jamison Battle is averaging 2.6 made 3-pointers over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Pistons: 7-3, averaging 116.3 points, 41.3 rebounds, 28.3 assists, 10.3 steals and 5.2 blocks per game while shooting 47.3% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 109.7 points per game. Raptors: 2-8, averaging 109.6 points, 38.8 rebounds, 27.8 assists, 8.4 steals and 4.2 blocks per game while shooting 45.4% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 114.9 points. INJURIES: Pistons: Jalen Duren: out (hamstring), Ronald Holland II: day to day (knee), Taurean Prince: day to day (knee), Duncan Robinson: out (quadriceps), Cade Cunningham: day to day (knee). Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: out (knee), Nate Bittle: out (foot), Scottie Barnes: day to day (groin), Collin Murray-Boyles: day to day (illness), RJ Barrett: day to day (hamstring). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
